note_en: 连 … 都/也 … means "even": 连 puts the most extreme, unexpected case up front, and 都 or 也 before the verb confirms it is included. In the text: 连周末的自习室都坐满了人 "even on weekends the study hall was full"; 他连最拿手的数学都没及格 "he failed even math, his best subject"; 连说话的声音都变了 "even your voice has changed." English just says "even," but Chinese frames the item on both sides.
